name: Kimi ga Kiete Shimau Mae ni
original_name: キミが消えてしまう前に
source:
Due to certain circumstances, Akito, a high school student, is forced to transfer from his old school.

He accidentally wanders into an abandoned school inhabited by ghosts who harbor lingering attachments and are unable to rest in peace.

"I Have a Request for You"

Akito encounters a ghost girl named Nano at the abandoned school, who asks him to help one of the ghosts, named Tsukushi and Iroha, rest in peace.

Akito, who desires to live a life that is useful to others, follows Nano's words and begins attending the abandoned school to help the ghosts rest in peace.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3971860/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
由于某些情况，高中生明人被迫从原来的学校转学。

他无意中误入了一所废弃的学校，里面住满了心有余悸、无法安息的鬼魂。

“我有一个请求要拜托你”

明人在废弃的学校遇到了一个名叫奈诺的幽灵女孩，她请求他帮助其中一个名叫筑紫和彩羽的幽灵安息。

渴望过一种对他人有用的生活的明人遵循纳诺的话，开始进入废弃的学校，帮助鬼魂安息。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3971860/]Steam[/url]]
